sentences.text: This appeal is by the claimants for enhancement of the amount of compensation under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act.
Notices were issued to the respondents.

Office report dated 01.10.2024 is as under:
"R1, R2, R3 & R5 - Notice sent not yet returned.
(Acknowledgments not received from the common High Court at Hyderabad). R4 - Not necessary party vide C.T."
The present respondent Nos.1, 3 and 5 are respondents in MVOP No.777 of 2018 who were set ex parte.
The appellant serve respondent Nos.2 and 4 through their counsel on panel.
Post the matter after four (04) weeks.
